card.name: Word right after "with"
card.fires_on: The first word or word-start right after "with" in drug-label phrases, such as "with active peptic ulcer" or "with strong CYP3A inducers". It often sits at the start of a condition, drug or term.

modes.label: Start of a term after with
modes.description: A condition or drug name begins right after "with", often split into pieces.

modes.label: Adjective after with
modes.description: An adjective that modifies a condition or drug class follows "with".
modes.example: INLURIYO with<< strong>> CYP3A inducers. If

modes.label: Other mid-phrase spots
modes.description: Occasional hits on "and" or partway through a word in lists and assay descriptions.

card.plain: It fires on the first word or word-start after "with" when a condition or drug is being named.
